title: How the F-150 Stays No. 1 for 50 Years (Even Though GM Sells More Trucks)
description:
How the Ford F-Series stays America's best-selling truck for 49 straight years (and is on track for 50): the one-name strategy, Super Duty, fleets, hybrids, halo trucks and pricing, plus the cracks: the aluminum plant fire, a record 153 recalls and GM's combined sales. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:01 Reason 1: The name
4:46 Reason 2: Super Duty
6:02 Reason 3: Businesses and fleets
7:52 Reason 4: An engine for everyone
10:56 Reason 5: Halo trucks and pricing
13:06 The cracks: fire, recalls, supply
17:31 Can anyone end the streak?
19:48 What it means for buyers
20:45 The verdict
